news.title: BTC USD Closes Above $80,000 After the Democratic Sweep While Trump-Branded Assets Crash: Did the Midterms Flip Crypto Sentiment?
news.body: Bitcoin (BTC USD price) closed above $80,000 on Wednesday, November 4, the day after Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress, rising 3.9% while Trump-branded assets sank, with Trump Media stock down 24.5% and the TRUMP memecoin down 19.9%. That is not the reaction many in crypto expected from a Democratic Congress. Bitcoin traded.. The post BTC USD Closes Above $80,000 After the Democratic Sweep While Trump-Branded Assets Crash: Did the Midterms Flip Crypto Sentiment? appeared first on 99Bitcoins.
